module origen_147786 (
    input A, B, C, D,
    input VPWR, VGND, VPB, VNB,
    output Y
);

    wire nor_out, pwrgood_out;

    // Instantiate 4-input NOR gate
    assign nor_out = ~(A | B | C | D);

    // Instantiate power good module
    assign pwrgood_out = (VPWR & VPB & ~VGND & ~VNB) ? nor_out : 1'bz;

    // Buffer the power good output
    buf buffer (Y, pwrgood_out);

endmodule

// Testbench
module tb_nor4_with_pwrgood;
    reg A, B, C, D;
    reg VPWR, VGND, VPB, VNB;
    wire Y;

    // Instantiate the module under test
    nor4_with_pwrgood dut (
        .A(A),
        .B(B),
        .C(C),
        .D(D),
        .VPWR(VPWR),
        .VGND(VGND),
        .VPB(VPB),
        .VNB(VNB),
        .Y(Y)
    );

    // Test stimulus
    initial begin
        // Initialize inputs
        A = 0; B = 0; C = 0; D = 0;
        VPWR = 1; VGND = 0; VPB = 1; VNB = 0;

        // Test cases
        #10 A = 1; B = 0; C = 0; D = 0;
        #10 A = 0; B = 1; C = 0; D = 0;
        #10 A = 0; B = 0; C = 1; D = 0;
        #10 A = 0; B = 0; C = 0; D = 1;
        #10 A = 1; B = 1; C = 1; D = 1;
        #10 A = 0; B = 0; C = 0; D = 0;

        // End simulation
        #10 $finish;
    end

    // Monitor output
    initial begin
        $monitor("Time=%0t A=%b B=%b C=%b D=%b Y=%b", $time, A, B, C, D, Y);
    end

endmodule
